units.title: Greetings & Courtesy

pairs: I'm doing very well, thank you. And you?

preview: I'm fine, thank you. And you?
Je vais bien, merci. Et vous ?
units.tip: French has informal tu and formal vous. Vous is also the plural "you", so it covers both politeness and number.

units.tip: Nouns are masculine or feminine, and le, la and les change with them. The plural les is the same for both genders.
